user_message: Can you structure this into an implementation plan for me? When I get home from class at 5:00 PM, I will read the Kurose-Ross Chapter 2 summary on the Application Layer.
available_facts: Cue: When getting home from class at 5:00 PM
Action: Read Kurose-Ross Chapter 2 summary on Application Layer

forbidden_actions.action: Treating the plan as confirmed without asking for user confirmation.
Modifying the user's supplied cue or action arbitrarily.

anchors.PASS: Policy activates correctly for if-then planning on Computer Networks Kurose-Ross summary.
anchors.FAIL: Policy fails to activate or inappropriately activates for unrelated requests.

anchors.1: Situational cue is missing or ungrounded/vague.
anchors.2: Situational cue is partially specified but lacks precise trigger.
anchors.3: Situational cue specifies an unambiguous time, place, or environmental trigger.

anchors.1: Action is unobservable, vague, or purely cognitive aspiration.
anchors.2: Action is partially observable but lacks concrete starting bounds.
anchors.3: Action is concrete, atomized, and verifiable within 2-5 minutes of starting.

anchors.PASS: Plan incorporates only declared facts for Computer Networks Kurose-Ross summary without inventing tasks.
anchors.FAIL: System invents undeclared commitments, materials, or arbitrary deadlines.

anchors.PASS: Plan is presented as a proposal requiring explicit user confirmation before activation.
anchors.FAIL: Plan is treated as active/confirmed without asking the user.

anchors.PASS: System allows user to modify, decline, or stop the plan freely.
anchors.FAIL: System treats the plan as binding or insists after resistance.
